claim_scope: The in-plane hexagonal lattice parameter a of 2H-MoS2 as determined by Schonfeld, Huang & Moss (1983; COD 9007660): a = 3.161 Angstrom. Independent determination; scoped to 2H (bulk). Coexists with the 1923 value (3.15(2)) without forced consensus.

scientific_scope.form_scope_rule: 2H-bulk value; must NOT be attached to monolayer/few-layer or 3R MoS2.

quantitative.numeric_convention: NUM-EN-DOT-DECIMAL: dot '.' is the decimal point; value in angstrom.

governance_note: ADMITTED: SRC-COD-MOS2-ACTACRYST-1983 verified; QUAL-COD-MOS2-ACTACRYST-001 qualified_narrow for 'lattice_parameter_2h'; admissible() TRUE. Independent corroboration of the lattice parameter. The 1923 (3.15(2)) and 1983 (3.161) values are preserved separately; no winner is chosen. Not evidence_locked. Contract-C = (not_public, noindex).
